item.title: AHD vs IP Cameras in Qatar — Which CCTV Type Should You Buy in 2026?
item.description: AHD cameras run on coaxial cable and are cheaper to install. IP cameras run on Cat6, give better image quality and remote access. Here is the honest comparison — and who should buy which.
